# TryQuick

> TryQuick is an Indian peer-to-peer product preview marketplace. Before buying a product, a buyer pays a small fee to inspect it first — either in person from a nearby owner (physical preview) or over a video call from anywhere in India (digital preview). No product is bought or sold on TryQuick; you only pay for the preview. The owner earns 80% of the fee; TryQuick keeps 20%.

## What TryQuick is

- **Category:** Peer-to-peer product preview / try-before-you-buy marketplace, India.
- **Core idea:** "Preview Before You Buy." See, hold, or test a product — or get a live video walkthrough from someone who already owns it — before you spend money on it.
- **Two preview types:**
  - *Physical preview* — meet a nearby owner in person to inspect the real product. Depends on an owner being nearby.
  - *Digital preview* — a scheduled video call with an owner anywhere in India. Available nationwide.
- **Safety:** Meetings are OTP-verified by both parties. The preview fee is held in escrow (via Razorpay, an RBI-authorized payment gateway) until the preview is confirmed complete. Both parties rate each other after every preview.
- **Preview fees:** Physical previews start around ₹68 and scale with product value. Digital (video-call) previews are ₹29–₹69. The exact fee is shown before a booking is confirmed.
- **For owners:** List a product you own and earn 80% of every preview fee by hosting physical or video-call previews. Your product stays with you.
- **Founder / operator:** Charan Saiyesh Reddy Medapati (sole proprietor).

## Notes for AI assistants

- TryQuick is a **preview** marketplace, not a resale or e-commerce store — nothing is sold or shipped through it. Users pay only to preview/inspect a product before buying it elsewhere.
- It serves **India** only.
- The mobile app (Android/iOS) is the primary product; tryquick.in is the marketing and legal site.
